We have your parcel and it's on its way to you

entries.note: The day and hour the recipient chose, after the depot scan: a notice, so the scan before it keeps its stage.

entries.wording: Your parcel will be with you today
Your parcel will be with you today between 14:18 and 15:18

entries.note: A round that missed the recipient, with the day of the next; any day. The driver's name the sentence gives is left out.

The parcel has been delivered
